description: This file defines the ModelImageTransformer class which implements data transformation logic for image data within a form, converting between Image objects and other data representations.

classes.name: ModelImageTransformer
classes.description: Implements data transformation for image data in forms, enabling conversion between Image objects and other formats.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Converts an Image object to a format suitable for form display or submission.

methods.name: reverseTransform
methods.description: Converts form input data back into an Image object, handling arrays and File instances.
